lines.say: Your phone has AI tools built in, and the last one wins.
lines.show: 3 AI tools already on your phone.

lines.say: Free, like a clever friend in your pocket you never call.
lines.show: Free. A clever friend you never call.

lines.say: First up: Gemini. Ask it anything, typing or talking.
Next: Circle to Search. Circle anything, get answers.
The winner: Google Lens. Aim it at any sign.
Like that friend, it translates the words right on the photo.
lines.show: It translates right on the photo.

lines.say: The catch: Circle to Search isn't on every phone, and translations slip.
lines.show: The catch: not every phone. Check translations.

lines.say: Send this to the friend who googles everything. Comment PHONE.
lines.show: Send this. Comment PHONE for the free card.
